50 min – 1h30 (less if you already have the keys)

Cross the {wiki:Hellgate}, beneath Ab'Dendriel, to the pyramid of {wiki:Draconia}. Floor by floor you find keys 3001 to 3008, solve small puzzles and, with the help of at least one companion, reach the chests with the {item:Ice Rapier}, {item:Serpent Sword}, {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and {item:Energy Ring}.
You will have to solve puzzles to get the keys and climb the pyramid.
Level 25 (for the {item:Gate of Expertise} of the chests).
At least **1 more trustworthy player** (there are switches on the floor that need two people).
Hellgate entrance key (Elathriel sells it for 5000 gp)
or the Browse Field spell, to reveal keys 3004 and 3006
optional, to trade for a Dragonfetish (emergency exit)
or the {spell:Levitate} spell: only if you have to leave through the Hellgate (emergency exit)
Keys 3001 to 3007 are **daily** respawns: if another player has already picked them up today, you have to buy them or borrow them. The keys are used in numerical order.
Bring only trusted companions: at the switches on the third floor you can get trapped if they leave you there.

Emergency exits to Ab'Dendriel: trade a {item:White Mushroom} for a {item:Dragonfetish} with {npc:An Old Dragonlord} and use it to teleport; or go back to the Hellgate and leave by the normal route with levitation (very close to the Draconia entrance).
Since you are in Draconia, take the chance to pick up the book for the {wiki:Realm of Dreams Quest}.

Go to **Ab'Dendriel** (by boat: tell your city's captain {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull}). In the city, go to the {wiki:Shadow Caves}, underground **northwest** of the depot: go down to the shop floor and then go down again next to the little houses.

Go down 2 more floors and follow the cave **south** and then **east** to a normally locked door: the Hellgate entrance. Open it with the {item:Key 3012}. If you don't have the key, buy it from the prison guard nearby, {npc:Elathriel}, for 5000 gp.
Path to the Hellgate (3): the door is to the east

Enter the **north** teleport to enter the Hellgate and follow the route in the image. The route ends at the {wiki:Redbone Castle}; from there on the path is one-way up to the surface of Draconia, so you can't get lost.
Route through the Hellgate to Draconia
Redbone Castle (end of the route map)

You may meet {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms}, rarely the {creature:Rotworm Queen}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and sometimes lured {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}. If you meet anything else, you took a wrong turn.

From the {wiki:Redbone Castle} on, the path is **one-way** and takes you up to {wiki:Draconia}, an island off the **northeast** coast of Ab'Dendriel ({coord:32802,31589,7}). There is no boat or other entrance: the only access is this tunnel under the sea. On the surface there are only {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. Enter the pyramid: the ground floor starts next to the hole you come in by.
Draconia has no normal exit: you can only leave through the portal on the 7th floor (end of the quest), with a {item:Dragonfetish} or by walking back through the Hellgate (see the last section).

From the hole you came in by, head to the **northwest** side of the pyramid. Open the skeleton corpses until you find the {item:Key 3001}. You may need to move some corpses aside until you find the right one.
Search the skeleton corpses until you find Key 3001 (you may need to move some corpses aside)

Go back to the hole and head **south**. Open the **east** door with Key 3001 and walk **north** to a red carpet. Walk along the **south** row of the carpet. On the other side, open the **second** coffin on the north side of the room to take the {item:Key 3002}.
Walk along the red carpet: watch out for the holes (they only show up after you fall into them)
Open the coffin to find Key 3002
The carpet squares burn and electrocute, and 2 of them are hidden holes that make you fall next to 10 {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} (they only show up when you fall into them).

Go back to where Key 3001 was and head **south**, to the **southwest** part of the pyramid. Open the door with Key 3002 and pull the lever (it destroys a wall to the north). Go **north** and pull the other lever that was behind the wall (it makes a stone disappear). Go back **south**, to where the stone was, and pick up the {item:Key 3003}.
Pull the lever to destroy the wall to the north
Pull the lever behind the wall (already destroyed) to make the stone disappear
Go back and pick up Key 3003
Going up to the second floor
Go around and use Key 3003 on the **west** door in the **southeast** corner of the pyramid. Continue to the stairs and go up.

From the stairs head **south** and then **east**. You see a room full of {item:Energy Field|Energy Fields}. Use a {item:Destroy Field Rune} (or {spell:Browse Field}) on the square in the **first row, third column**. The {item:Key 3004} appears.
Key 3004 is under an Energy Field in the first row, third column

From the Key 3004 spot, head **south**. Open the door to the south with Key 3004; inside the room go **west** and follow the path until you find the {item:Key 3005} on the floor, next to the statues (southwest room).
Key 3005 is on the floor of the southwest room (you need Key 3004 to get there)

Go back to the stairs you arrived by and now head **west**. Open the door with Key 3005: it is another room with fields, this time fire with some energy. Use the {item:Destroy Field Rune} (or {spell:Browse Field}) on the **southeasternmost** square to reveal the {item:Key 3006} and pick it up.
Key 3006 is under a Fire Field in the northwest room (you need Key 3005 to get there)
Going up to the third floor
Go back **south** and open the last locked door with Key 3006. Go up the stairs.
There are 6–8 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and 2 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}. This guide assumes 2 players (with 3, each one can have their own role).
From the stairs, follow the path to two switches on the floor. **Player 1** stands on the **south** switch: the southwest room opens.
Player 1 stays here: the southwest room opens
**Player 2** goes **west**, enters the **southwest** room and stands on the switch there: the northwest room opens.
Player 2 stays here: the northwest room opens
**Player 1** steps off the switch, goes **west** and then **north**, enters the portal and picks up the {item:Key 3007}.
Player 1 (or a 3rd player) enters the portal
Player 1 (or a 3rd player) picks up the key
**Player 1** goes back to the switch where they were before; only then can **Player 2** leave the room. Both go up the stairs.
If Player 1 does not go back to the switch, Player 2 gets trapped.
Follow the path to the locked door, open it with the {item:Key 3007}, go through and go up.
There are no puzzles: cross the floor to the next stairs and go up.
Pass the level 25 {item:Gate of Expertise} and open the chests to receive the reward: {item:Ice Rapier}, {item:Serpent Sword}, {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and {item:Energy Ring}.
Ice Rapier, Serpent Sword, Stone Skin Amulet and Energy Ring
Open the **west** bookshelf to take the {item:Key 3008}. This one is not a daily respawn: each player can take one. Then go up.
Take Key 3008 from the west bookshelf
There are no creatures on this floor.
Open the door with the {item:Key 3008}. Set the levers to the **left – right – left – right** position and enter the portal. You appear at the sacrificial stone of **Ab'Dendriel**, near the temple.
Set the levers to left – right – left – right and enter the portal

If you can't finish the quest, take a {item:White Mushroom} to {npc:An Old Dragonlord}, at the top of the mountain in the north of the island ({coord:32796,31557,2}). Just greet him ({key:hi}) with the mushroom in your backpack to trade it for a {item:Dragonfetish}. Sacrifice the fetish in the exit teleport room, in the {creature:Dragon} lair beneath the **southeast** of the island, and you are teleported to **Ab'Dendriel**.
You only receive one Dragonfetish: if you lose it before using it you don't get another. In the teleport room there is a {creature:Dragon}.

You can also walk back: go down again to the Redbone Castle and leave by the normal {wiki:Hellgate} route (see {wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}), which passes very close to the Draconia entrance. You need a {item:Rope} and **6 {item:Parcel|Parcels} or the {spell:Levitate} spell** to go up 2 floors on one of the stretches. The route: go up the platform stairs, follow the corridor **west** and go down the indicated holes, use the rope on the rope spots, cross the big room of {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} hugging the **south** wall, go down, head **northwest** (no creatures) and go up 2 floors with parcels/Levitate and the stairs; then head **southwest**, go up through the hole, pull the bridge lever if it is closed and follow the only way up (lots of {creature:Wasp|Wasps}). You come out on the surface near Ab'Dendriel ({coord:32603,31705,7}).

On the way there are {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Wasp|Wasps} and, at times, lured {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}.
The quest uses 9 keys: the {item:Key 3012} (Hellgate entrance) and the silver keys 3001 to 3008 from Draconia, used in ascending order.
